closed_loop: only if the offline gate passes: candidate (F40 + the fitted heads, greedy) vs reference (F40 + default turns) on the fresh held-out world-episodes, M5's floors; pass iff g ≥ −F and deaths, run-down and starvation shares no worse (EXP-0123's reading: gain g > F, cost g < −F or worse side effects, else no_cost); 42 reported; then EXP-0123's diagnostic (accept agreement in closed loop, differing bits, pending fates) on a second fresh episode set (stage m6-turn-imit-v15-closed-loop)
data: F40 + default turns: 112 M4 training world-episodes × r0/r1 (fit); held out: the 16 monitor worlds × 1 fresh episode (stage m6-turn-imit-v15-heldout, never played) × r0/r1
features: v14's log rows + v15's linear own-state fractions (fund +1, bid / claim +3) + the arrival position of each bid / claim (own state, the domain's tie-break order); no cumulative feature
fit: 30 epochs over the full training turns, cosine LR from 3e-3 over the whole run, batch 512, ≤ 400 pairs per turn, seed 0, the ranking loss alone for the first 3 epochs, declined bids ranked, the student's own order; the final model is read (no early stopping, no best epoch); a checkpoint each epoch for crash safety only (resume continues the same run)
heads: 3 pre-norm self-attention layers (4 heads, width 32) over each turn's items, then for the accept turn a gated additive recurrent pass over [reservations, pending, bids] in the heads' own bounded, detached priority order (ties: input order = the domain's kind order); bounded 10·tanh scores with a 1e-4 pre-tanh penalty
offline_gate: fresh held-out turns, bounded / clipped scores: accept agreement ≥ 0.99, accept-turn rank (claims + accepted bids, v13's exclusions) ≥ 0.99, fund rank ≥ 0.99; reported: the tie-dependent / determinable split, the slack split, ties, saturation
stage: EXP-0126: turn-head imitation with the ordered accept pass, linear fractions and arrival position
